description: Revenue per employee/FTE with explicit inputs, same-quarter state ranking across banks and/or credit unions. sector='both', 'bank' or 'credit_union'. revenue_basis='net' (after interest expense, default) or 'gross'. Annualized year-to-date run rate, not actual full-year revenue. State filters headquarters. Banks use reported FTE; CUs estimated full-time + half part-time, not identical definitions. Invalid denominators and known reporting-perimeter breaks excluded from ranks and counted. Optional cu_number/cert selects that institution but keeps full peer rank. No raw SQL.
name: revenue_per_employee
